about.bio: I am a BSc Information Technology student at the University of Johannesburg still keeping my overall average at +75%, a Computer Science 1B Assistant specializing in C++ instruction. I am a natural problem-solver with a lifelong love for mathematics that drives my analytical thinking. I am equally passionate about the arts and philosophy, finding immense value in rich, logical discussions, writing poetry, composing music, and playing the piano. Whether I am debugging a system or writing a melody, I am always searching for elegant solutions.
